findings.summary: The condition `if (fileLines && !fileContent)` on line 224 permanently disables bounded context and symbol extraction, and incorrectly triggers the full-diff fallback on attempt 3 for unmodified lines.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the logic to unconditionally set `hasBoundedContext = true` if `fileLines` exists, and only push the bounded context/symbol sections inside an `if (attempt === 1)` block.

findings.summary: The regex `new RegExp("\\b" + escapedTargetName + "[.\\w]\\b", 'g')` in `findDeterministicCallers` incorrectly matches unrelated symbols (e.g. matching `FooA` when searching for `Foo`).
findings.suggested_fix: Change the caller pattern to match the target name as an exact word boundary: `new RegExp("\\b" + escapedTargetName + "\\b", 'g')`.
